acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Steampunk style When color palette Then features brass, copper, dark mahogany, steam white
Given Victorian Steampunk style When typography Then uses victorian fonts: Cinzel, IM Fell English, or Playfair Display

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Steampunk style When layout Then gear mechanisms, pipe networks, leather textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: rotating gear decorations (3 gears), brass border with gear symbol, pipe divider with joints, dark leather-brown gradient background

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Steampunk style When UI elements Then brass buttons, gear animations, leather panels

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Steampunk UI When functional Then includes workshop chat, inventor agents, steam stats
